/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 - <<'PY'
from urllib.parse import parse_qsl, urlsplit, urlunsplit
from solution import patch_query

cases = [
    ('/p?a=1&b=&a=2&bare#frag', [], [('a','1'),('b',''),('a','2'),('bare','')]),
    ('/p?a=1&b=2&a=3&c=4', [('a','x')], [('b','2'),('c','4'),('a','x')]),
    ('?a=1&a=2&b=', [('a', None)], [('b','')]),
    ('?a=1', [('a','')], [('a','')]),
    ('?a=1&b=2', [('a','x'),('b','y'),('a','z')], [('b','y'),('a','z')]),
    ('?a=1', [('a','x'),('a',None),('a','')], [('a','')]),
    ('?A=1&%61=2&a=3', [('a','4')], [('A','1'),('a','4')]),
    ('?a+b=1&a%2Bb=2', [('a b',None)], [('a+b','2')]),
    ('relative/path', [('雪 &+%=', 'é 雪 &+%=')], [('雪 &+%=', 'é 雪 &+%=')]),
    ('?=old&x=1', [('', '')], [('x','1'),('','')]),
    ('#fragment', [('missing',None)], []),
]
for url, updates, expected in cases:
    original = updates.copy()
    result = patch_query(url, updates)
    assert parse_qsl(urlsplit(result).query, keep_blank_values=True) == expected, result
    assert updates == original
    assert patch_query(url, (pair for pair in updates)) == result
    before, after = urlsplit(url), urlsplit(result)
    assert (before.scheme,before.netloc,before.path,before.fragment) == (after.scheme,after.netloc,after.path,after.fragment)
for url in ['HTTPS://User:Pass@Example.invalid:443/a%2Fb?x=1#f%20g', '//host/path?a=#', '../path?x=1#abc', 'mailto:a@example.invalid?subject=hello#part']:
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    expected = urlunsplit(parts._replace(query='x=2'))
    assert patch_query(url, [('subject',None),('a',None),('x','2')]) == expected
print('Passed 11 edge-case scenarios, input/generator checks, and 4 URL-component checks.')
PY"
